title: Italian Supermarket Flyers & Deals Scraper
description: Extract current promotional products from Italian supermarket flyers. Structured API records are returned by default; lower-quality preview fallback data can be optionally included.

catena.title: Supermarket chain
catena.description: Select one chain or scrape all supported grocery chains.

keyword.title: Product keyword filter (optional)
keyword.description: Return only products whose name or source category contains the term, for example: pasta, birra, latte, detersivo.

structuredOnly.title: Return only structured API-quality records
structuredOnly.description: Recommended. Excludes preview-only fallback records, such as currently available Esselunga preview items, from the output dataset.

maxItems.title: Maximum products for a single selected chain
maxItems.description: Used only when you select a single supermarket chain.

maxItemsPerChain.title: Maximum products per chain when scraping all
maxItemsPerChain.description: Used for All grocery chains. The default is above the currently validated Famila catalogue size, so large chains are not silently cut while each chain still has its own safety cap.

maxTotalItems.title: Maximum total products when scraping all
maxTotalItems.description: Safety ceiling for an all-chains run. Keep this greater than the expected sum of products across chains for full coverage.

diagnosticMode.title: Save API diagnostics
diagnosticMode.description: Stores API response diagnostics for structured flyers. Use for development only.

investigateZeroResults.title: Investigate chains without structured products
investigateZeroResults.description: Development mode: for chains returning zero API products, saves page HTML, screenshot, DOM audit and click probes. Does not change extracted output.
